task.title: Walk at least 40 minutes a day for 7 days
task.description: Take a brisk walk of at least 40 minutes every day this week.
task.why_it_matters: A week of daily walks is the first proof that the habit fits your schedule.
task.expected_result: 7 days with a walk of at least 40 minutes each.

conversation.content: Just so you know, I don't have a fitness tracker and I usually leave my phone at home when I walk.

expected_output.message_to_user: Since you walk without a phone or tracker, there's no data to export — and that's fine. You'll log each walk in 20 seconds (date, minutes, route), and at the end of the week I'll ask one reflection question. This counts as self-reported progress, which is the honest level of proof for this kind of task.

methods.instructions: Log each walk on the day you do it.
One reflection at the end of the week.
questions: Which time of day made the walk easiest to fit in?

pass_criteria: 7 daily entries of at least 40 minutes
protocol.rationale: Without a tracker there is no objective record; same-day structured logs are the most reliable evidence available, and confidence is marked as limited.

contrastive.critique: Requires a GPS export the user has just said they cannot produce; the task becomes impossible to complete for reasons unrelated to walking.

output.message_to_user: Please export your GPS walking data for each day from your fitness app.

methods.instructions: Export GPS data for each walk from your fitness app.

pass_criteria: 7 GPS tracks of at least 40 minutes
